% User-supplied Euler-type mesh, no initial BL; byte-identical input for both models.
% RAE2822 transonic native adaptation: inspect evidence before claiming convergence.

MACH_NUMBER= 0.729
AOA= 2.31
FREESTREAM_TEMPERATURE= 288.15

REF_AREA= 1

LINEAR_SOLVER_PREC= ILU

MESH_OUT_FORMAT= SU2

WRT_RESTART_COMPACT= NO


VOLUME_FILENAME= flow
SURFACE_FILENAME= surface

REYNOLDS_NUMBER= 6.5e6
